updates.text: Eighteen of the 26 kicking-game snaps and no defensive snap, with no tackle recorded. A minor upper-extremity injury was logged at 10:35 of the second quarter at the end of Pittsburgh's three-and-out that ended in Wing's 54-yard punt; he was not removed: out, projected return October 6, reassessment October 6 ([medical record](career/2014/Team_Operations/Medical/incidents/christian_jones_2014-10-05.md)). No role change follows.

short.text: Christian Jones is a rookie linebacker who has made {{2014.regular.special_teams_tackles:words}} special-teams tackles in {{2014.regular.games:words}} games. He is a big linebacker who played both middle and outside linebacker at Florida State, with the size and strength for the strong side and experience on coverage units. His instincts and change of direction are the questions.

transactions.text: Signed a three-year contract with Jacksonville as an undrafted rookie
